customManagers.description: The hubble-ui-backend image the e2e harness compiles and runs against by default. Not a normal dependency: it must stay in step with the github.com/cilium/hubble-ui/backend module pin, so it is grouped with it below. Deliberately scoped to e2e_test.go only: the E2E matrix in .github/workflows/e2e.yml lists OLDER versions on purpose, and bumping those would collapse the matrix onto one version and silently retire the back-compat coverage. Matrix entries are written as bare tags so this regex cannot match them either way. TestE2EMatrixCoversDefaultPin fails if a bump here leaves the matrix behind.

packageRules.description: The hubble-ui backend module, the backend image and the frontend image are all views of the same release. We parse hubble-ui's internal customprotocol, which carries no compatibility promise, and the chart now deploys the frontend and backend itself, so all of them must move together and none may automerge.
prBodyNotes: **Do not merge on green CI alone.**

The correct pairing is whatever Cilium ships, not the newest of each: check `hubble.ui.backend.image.tag` in `install/kubernetes/cilium/values.yaml` for the Cilium version you deploy, and set both to match.
The e2e suite verifies our filter against this image, so a mismatched pairing means the tests pass against a backend nobody runs.

packageRules.description: Cilium supplies the flow protos. Pinned to the oldest supported line on purpose (see go.mod), so major bumps are a deliberate support-window decision.
k8s.io/* move in lockstep; splitting them produces unbuildable combinations.
